summary: The main article describes a nickel/photoredox-catalyzed direct carbamoylation of (hetero)aryl bromides using 4-carbamoyl-1,4-dihydropyridines. The document includes optimization studies, a general synthesis scheme for the radical precursors, and extensive scope evaluations for both aryl bromides and carbamoyl precursors.

items.heading: Figure 1. The presented radical cross-coupling approach to amide synthesis under photoredox-nickel dual catalysis.
items.description: This figure illustrates the general catalytic strategy combining nickel and photoredox catalysis to couple dihydropyridines with aryl bromides.

items.heading: Figure 2. Scope of (hetero)aryl bromides.

items.description: Shows the range of dihydropyridines used to install different amide moieties, including amino acids, peptides, and secondary/tertiary amides.
